spec.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Night City Map
spec.genInstructions: Build a stylized Night City map with district labels, fast-travel points, vendor/ripperdoc icons and quest/gig markers, plus zoom/pan and a route/tracked-marker highlight. It is the spatial navigation hub for the world.
spec.role: The world navigation view that displays and routes to the currently tracked quest, staying in sync with the quest journal in both directions.

effectors.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Quest Journal
effectors.description: When the user tracks a job/gig in the journal, receive its location and plot/highlight the corresponding marker and route on the map, panning to center it.

targets.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Quest Journal
targets.description: When the user clicks a quest/gig marker on the map, emit that quest's id so the journal scrolls to and highlights the matching entry and marks it as the tracked job.

library.description: Displays a character's portrait image in a framed viewport; purely visual readout, no interaction.
Horizontal filled bar showing a quantity; fill fraction is value/max clamped to 0-1. Optional segmented rendering for discrete pips.
Compact alphanumeric readout of a single datum (number or text) with optional unit and delta; read-only. Value units are supplied by the component.
Row of active status-effect indicators, each with an id, icon glyph, optional stack count and optional remaining duration in seconds.

props.effects: { id: string; label: string; icon?: string; stacks?: number; remaining?: number; tone?: 'buff' | 'debuff' }[]

library.description: Digital time readout; time is supplied as a preformatted string or epoch milliseconds and ticks only if the component updates it.
Increment/decrement control pair around a numeric value; emits the new value clamped within min..max and stepping by step.
Read-only list of perk entries showing name, tier/rank and locked/unlocked state.

props.perks: { id: string; label: string; description?: string; rank?: number; maxRank?: number; unlocked?: boolean }[]

props.points?: { id: string; x: number; y: number }[]

library.description: A single equip socket showing an occupying item (icon, name, rarity, stats) or an empty state; clicking emits the slot id. Position is normalized 0-1 when placed on a surface.

spec.name: Cyberpunk 2077: V Vitals Status HUD
spec.genInstructions: Build a neon-glitch character status HUD showing V's portrait, health bar, armor rating, stamina bar, active status effects, level indicator, Street Cred progress, an eddies counter and a system clock. It is the live readout of the player's core survivability and resources, aggregating buffs from attributes, cyberware and equipped gear.
spec.role: The central character survivability readout that consolidates health, armor, stamina, level, Street Cred and currency, reflecting modifiers pushed to it by the attributes, cyberware, weapons and quest components.

effectors.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Attributes & Perks Panel
effectors.description: When the user allocates points into an attribute, the panel emits the new attribute values; this HUD recomputes and re-renders the affected max values — Body raises max Health, Reflexes/Cool adjust stamina and crit-related status, updating the corresponding bars.

effectors.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Cyberware Ripperdoc Loadout
effectors.description: When an implant is equipped/unequipped, the loadout emits the aggregate stat bonuses (armor, health regen, extra health, status resistances); this HUD adds/removes those bonuses and updates the health/armor bars and status-effect icons.

effectors.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Weapons & Inventory Loadout
effectors.description: When clothing/armor gear is equipped, the loadout emits its combined armor rating; this HUD updates the Armor value display accordingly.

effectors.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Quest Journal
effectors.description: When a job/gig is marked complete, the journal emits its Street Cred and eddies rewards; this HUD increments the Street Cred progress bar (and level-up state) and the eddies counter.

spec.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Cyberware Ripperdoc Loadout
spec.genInstructions: Build a body-diagram implant loadout with slots per body region (frontal cortex, ocular, nervous system, circulatory, skeleton, arms, legs, integumentary), each showing the equipped cyberware and its bonuses, plus a Cyberware Capacity meter. It lets the player equip/swap implants that augment V.
spec.role: The augmentation manager where implants are equipped into body slots, drawing its capacity from the attributes panel and pushing stat bonuses to the vitals HUD.

effectors.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Attributes & Perks Panel
effectors.description: Receives the updated Technical Ability value and recalculates the Cyberware Capacity meter, enabling or blocking implant slots when capacity is exceeded.

targets.name: Cyberpunk 2077: V Vitals Status HUD
targets.description: When an implant is equipped or removed, emit the aggregate stat bonuses (armor, extra/regen health, status resistances) so the Vitals HUD updates its health/armor bars and status-effect display.
